sections.title: HX-500 Vertical Machining Center - Operator and Maintenance Manual (Rev C)
sections.summary: HX-500 Vertical Machining Center - Operator and Maintenance Manual (Rev C)

sections.title: 1. About this manual
sections.summary: This manual covers the HX 500 vertical machining center built from serial number HX5 2201 onwards (Rev C controller, firmware 4.x).

sections.title: 2. Safety
sections.summary: 2. Safety

sections.title: 2.1 General safety rules
sections.summary: Never open the enclosure door while the spindle is turning.

sections.title: 2.2 Emergency stop
sections.summary: Press the red EMERGENCY STOP button on the operator panel or on the side of the enclosure.

sections.title: 2.3 Lockout / tagout
sections.summary: Before any maintenance task marked (L2), and before opening the electrical cabinet, apply lockout/tagout as described in the Plant Safety Standard, section 4.

sections.title: 3. Specifications
sections.summary: Item Value Table size 1,100 x 500 mm Max table load 600 kg Travel X / Y / Z 850 / 510 / 560 mm Spindle taper BT40 Spindle speed 50 12,000 rpm Spindle power 15 kW (30 min rating), 11 kW continuous Tool magazine 24 tools M

sections.title: 4. Installation
sections.summary: 4. Installation

sections.title: 4.1 Foundation
sections.summary: The machine must stand on a reinforced concrete floor at least 200 mm thick.

sections.title: 4.2 Environment
sections.summary: Ambient temperature 10 35 °C, relative humidity below 75 % (non condensing).

sections.title: 4.3 Electrical connection
sections.summary: The machine must be connected by a qualified electrician to a dedicated circuit protected by a 63 A slow blow fuse.

sections.title: 5. Operation
sections.summary: 5. Operation

sections.title: 5.2 Spindle warm-up
sections.summary: Run program O9000 (warm up) whenever the spindle has been stopped for more than 4 hours, and always at the start of each shift.

sections.title: 5.3 Loading tools
sections.summary: Tools are loaded at the tool change station with the spindle stopped.

sections.title: 5.4 Running a program
sections.summary: Select the program, run it first in DRY RUN mode with the feed override at 25 % and single block on, then run the first part with the rapid override at 25 %.

sections.title: 5.5 Shutdown
sections.summary: At the end of the last shift: remove chips from the table, park the axes with program O9010, switch the coolant pump off, and switch off the main isolator.

sections.title: 6. Alarms and error codes
sections.summary: Code Meaning Operator action Escalate to A101 Air pressure low (below 6 bar) Check the compressor and the air filter; machine stops at the end of the current block Maintenance if not cleared in 15 min A102 Way lube oil l

sections.title: 6.2 Spindle over-temperature (A302)
sections.summary: Stop the cycle and let the spindle idle with the chiller running for 30 minutes.

sections.title: 7. Maintenance
sections.summary: 7. Maintenance

sections.title: 7.1 Maintenance schedule
sections.summary: Interval Task Done by Daily Clean chips from table and enclosure; check air, lube and coolant levels Operator Weekly Clean the coolant tank strainer; check the way covers for damage; drain the air filter water Operator M

sections.title: 7.2 Lubrication
sections.summary: Point Lubricant Quantity Interval Way lube tank ISO VG 68 slideway oil 2 liters Refill when below half Hydraulic unit ISO VG 32 hydraulic oil 12 liters Replace every 2,000 hours Tool changer cam NLGI 2 lithium grease 10

sections.title: 7.3 Drawbar force check (L2)
sections.summary: The drawbar clamping force must be between 12 and 14 kN for BT40 tools.

sections.title: 7.4 Coolant
sections.summary: Use water miscible coolant at 6 8 % concentration (refractometer reading x 1.0 for Helix Cool 300).

sections.title: 7.5 Ballscrew backlash (L2)
sections.summary: Measure the backlash on each axis with a dial indicator.

sections.title: 8. Torque values
sections.summary: Fastener Size Torque Leveling bolt lock nut M24 200 Nm Vise to table M16 120 Nm Fixture to table M12 70 Nm Tool holder pull stud M16 100 Nm (BT40) Way cover screws M6 10 Nm

sections.title: 9. Warranty
sections.summary: The machine is covered for 24 months from installation or 6,000 spindle hours, whichever comes first.

sections.title: 1. Axis Drive maintenance
sections.summary: A loose hose on the axis drive causes vibration and must be lubricateed within 25 hours.

sections.title: 1.1 Adjust the axis drive coupling

sections.title: 1.2 Inspect the axis drive coupling
sections.summary: If the axis drive shows wear above 10 %, inspect the relay before the next shift.

sections.title: 1.3 Inspect the axis drive hose

sections.title: 1.6 Check the axis drive belt
sections.summary: Every 100 hours, record the axis drive sensor and note the result in the machine log.

sections.title: 1. Accounts and passwords
sections.summary: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and must not contain the user name.

sections.title: 2. Multi-factor authentication (MFA)
sections.summary: MFA is required for email, VPN, the ERP system and every administrator account.

sections.title: 3. Remote access
sections.summary: Remote access is only through the company VPN from a company laptop.

sections.title: 4. USB and removable media
sections.summary: USB storage devices are blocked on all office computers.

sections.title: 5. Software
sections.summary: Only software from the company software center may be installed.

sections.title: 6. Data classification
sections.summary: Class Examples Rules Public Product brochures No restrictions Internal Procedures, this standard Share only with employees and contractors under NDA Confidential Drawings, prices, supplier agreements Encrypt when sent ou

sections.title: 7. Incidents
sections.summary: Report suspected phishing with the "Report phishing" button in Outlook.

sections.title: 8. Exceptions
sections.summary: Exceptions to this standard need a written risk assessment and the approval of the chief information security officer (CISO).

sections.title: 1. Scope
sections.summary: This standard applies to all employees, contractors and visitors at the Pune and Chennai plants.

sections.title: 2. Personal protective equipment (PPE)

sections.summary: Visitors must be escorted at all times in production areas and wear safety shoes, safety glasses and a visitor vest.

sections.summary: Contractors must complete the safety induction (45 minutes) before starting work and receive a contractor badge valid for 12 months.

sections.title: 3. Incident reporting
sections.summary: 3. Incident reporting

sections.summary: Report every injury, near miss, fire, spill of more than 5 liters of oil or chemicals, and any damage to a machine guard.

sections.summary: Event Report to Deadline Serious injury (hospital treatment, fracture, amputation) Plant manager and EHS head by phone Immediately, within 1 hour Lost time injury EHS head Within 4 hours First aid injury Shift supervisor

sections.title: 3.3 Night shift
sections.summary: On the night shift (22:00 06:00) the shift supervisor acts for the plant manager for the first report.

sections.title: 5. Work permits

sections.title: 6. Forklifts
sections.summary: Only employees holding a valid Helix forklift license (renewed every 3 years) may drive forklifts.

sections.title: 7. Working hours and fatigue
sections.summary: No one may work more than 12 hours in a shift or more than 60 hours in a week, including overtime.

sections.title: 1.1 Scope
sections.summary: Arvind Metals supplies aluminium bar stock (grades 6061 T6 and 7075 T6) and steel bar (EN8, EN24) to the Helix Precision plants in Pune and Chennai.

sections.title: 1.2 Term
sections.summary: The agreement runs from 1 February 2025 to 31 January 2027 and renews automatically for one year unless either party gives 90 days' written notice.

sections.title: 1.3 Prices
sections.summary: Prices are fixed per quarter and linked to the LME aluminium price of the last month of the previous quarter.

sections.title: 1.4 Delivery
sections.summary: Delivery within 10 working days of the purchase order.

sections.title: 1.5 Payment terms
sections.summary: Payment within 60 days of the invoice date.

sections.title: 1.6 Late delivery penalty
sections.summary: For each full week of delay the supplier pays a penalty of 1 % of the value of the delayed order, up to a maximum of 5 % of the order value.

sections.title: 1.7 Quality
sections.summary: Each delivery must come with a mill test certificate.

sections.title: 1.8 Termination
sections.summary: Helix may terminate the agreement with 30 days' notice if on time delivery is below 85 % for two consecutive quarters.

sections.summary: Payment within 45 days of the invoice date.

sections.title: 2.3 Late delivery penalty (replaces 1.6)
sections.summary: For each full week of delay the supplier pays a penalty of 1.5 % of the value of the delayed order, up to a maximum of 7.5 % of the order value.
